name: Click Indicator
description: World-space animated click and hold indicator with six animations, independent hold visuals, displacement trails, per-player colours, rainbow mode, and performance controls.

general-title.name: General
general-title.description: Choose which parts of the indicator are active. Click bursts and hold visuals can now be used independently.

click-burst-enabled.name: Show Click Bursts
click-burst-enabled.description: Show the animated pulse when the jump/action button is pressed. Turn this off for a hold-only setup.

p1-enabled.name: Player 1
p1-enabled.description: Enable click and hold indicators for Player 1.

p2-enabled.name: Player 2
p2-enabled.description: Enable click and hold indicators for Player 2.

click-title.name: Click Effect
click-title.description: Appearance of the short-lived press/release animation.

animation.name: Animation
animation.description: Pulse expands, Ripple adds an echo, Implode shrinks, Crosshair adds four direction lines, Diamond uses four straight edges, and Helix uses a rotating arc.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the main click effect lasts.

scale-end.name: Peak Scale
scale-end.description: Final size of the main ring relative to the base ring size.

easing.name: Easing
easing.description: Linear is constant-speed, Ease Out starts quickly and settles, and Ease In/Out is smoother at both ends.

layer-count.name: Layers
layer-count.description: 1 is the lightest. 2 adds a softer ghost ring. 3 adds the short flash layer too.

additive-blend.name: Additive Glow
additive-blend.description: Uses additive blending for brighter overlapping strokes. Performance Mode disables this automatically.

release-burst.name: Release Burst
release-burst.description: Fire a second click effect when the button is released.

hold-title.name: Hold Indicator
hold-title.description: The persistent ring that stays with the player while the button is held.

hold-enabled.name: Hold Ring
hold-enabled.description: Keep a ring visible for the entire duration of a hold.

hold-follow.name: Follow Player
hold-follow.description: When disabled, the hold ring stays at the press position. When enabled, it tracks the player.

fade-duration.name: Hold Fade Duration
fade-duration.description: How long the hold visuals fade after release. This also controls the new hold trail's release fade.

trail-title.name: Hold Trail
trail-title.description: Draw a solid, high-opacity line from the exact hold start point to the player's current position. On release it freezes at the end point and fades.

hold-trail-enabled.name: Show Hold Trail
hold-trail-enabled.description: Enable the press-to-current displacement line. This can be used without the hold ring.

hold-trail-thickness.name: Trail Thickness
hold-trail-thickness.description: A thicker line is easier to read while moving quickly. 3.5 is intentionally much heavier than the hold ring.

hold-trail-start-marker.name: Mark Hold Start
hold-trail-start-marker.description: Draw a small circle at the exact position where the hold began, making the start and end points obvious.

colors-title.name: Colors
colors-title.description: Color sources shared by click effects, hold rings, and hold trails.

color-match-player.name: Match Player Colour
color-match-player.description: Use the player's current icon colour instead of the chosen Player 1/2 colour.

rainbow-mode.name: Rainbow Colours
rainbow-mode.description: Choose a rainbow hue at spawn time. This overrides the normal colour settings.

performance-title.name: Performance
performance-title.description: The renderer now builds ring geometry once and only animates transform/opacity. These settings control the remaining effect cost.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Force 16-segment rings, one pulse layer, a 12-effect cap, no Ripple echoes, no release burst, and non-additive blending.

ring-quality.name: Ring Quality
ring-quality.description: Balanced (24) is the recommended default. Higher values only affect geometry created when an effect spawns.

max-active-effects.name: Max Active Effects
max-active-effects.description: Hard cap for pulse/echo nodes. New effects are skipped once this limit is reached. Performance Mode forces this to 12.
